chars.F: FATHI: a young Moroccan DJ wearing a white oversized t-shirt with a thick gold chain and big black headphones around his neck.
chars.A: ANNA: a Swedish tourist woman wearing a bright red satin slip dress and small silver hoop earrings.
chars.M: MOUSTACHE: a huge, very muscular man twice as wide as the others, with a thick black handlebar moustache drawn on his white face, wearing a tight black t-shirt stretched over big muscles, black jeans and a big gold watch.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a crowded Casablanca nightclub with purple and blue lights. MOUSTACHE walks straight toward ANNA, who is dancing happily on the dance floor in the center. In the background, behind his DJ table with turntables, FATHI stares at them shocked, mouth open.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Nightclub dance floor, colored lights, blurred dancing crowd. MOUSTACHE and ANNA dance face to face very close, both smiling, he raises his big arms proudly.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Behind the DJ table in a nightclub, FATHI holds one side of his headphones and looks toward the dance floor with a worried jealous face, colorful lights behind him.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: ANNA dances joyfully with arms up under the disco lights on the crowded dance floor, carefree and laughing.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: On the dance floor ANNA turns back to MOUSTACHE and dances with him again, laughing, while he puts a big hand near her waist, nightclub lights.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: FATHI at his DJ table angrily pushes a fader and changes the song, frowning, sad blue spotlight on him, the nightclub crowd below.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: View from the DJ booth: in the foreground FATHI's back and headphones, he grips the edge of the DJ table; below on the dance floor MOUSTACHE and ANNA dance close together.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Close view on the dance floor: MOUSTACHE leans in close to ANNA, smirking confidently, she laughs, pink and purple lights.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Close view of FATHI behind the DJ table, heartbroken and furious, clenching his fist on the turntable, a red light behind him, dark nightclub.
